760130101.text: #Well, if it isn't the ever-reliable {NICKNAME}! We cross paths again — this must be "destiny" spun by moonlight, wouldn't you say?

760130103.text: Well, Lauma was way more reasonable than Aunt Rahetar. After I explained everything to her, she went quiet for about a minute...

760130104.text: Then she sent me to the library to help Ehrnrooth organize documents and copy hymns. She even said I don't have to go back to work in Nasha Town until I've sorted myself out! Isn't that the best reward?

760130105.text: #Oh, and while I was buried in hymn-copying these past few days, I finally started to get what Lady Aila meant when she said those things back then! Just like I thought, {NICKNAME}, you really are my lucky charm!

760130107.text: Have a question for me? I'm all ears!

760130142.text: #Mm-hmm, see you next time! Safe travels — uh, no, ahem... May the moonlight guide your path, {NICKNAME}.
